description: Generates final_provenance and proves it in a clean shell; batch mode for apps launched by a generated flux batch run.sh.
instructions: Run repro_build, repro_verify and repro_validate, and report the counts of the isolated run. Never edit the package by hand. In batch mode run repro_batch_selftest after any change and say what the isolated run did not exercise (app environment build, moirai venv build when reused).
